an8.24:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.24:1.2: athakho hatthako āḷavako pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an8.24:1.4: kathaṃ pana tvaṃ hatthaka imaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhāsīti.
an8.24:1.5: yānimāni bhante bhagavatā desitāni cattāri saṅgahavatthūni tehāhaṃ imaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhāmi
an8.24:1.7: ayaṃ dānena saṅgahetabboti taṃ dānena saṅgaṇhāmi
an8.24:1.9: ayaṃ peyyavācena saṅgahetabboti taṃ peyyavācena saṅgaṇhāmi
an8.24:1.11: ayaṃ atthacariyāya saṅgahetabboti taṃ atthacariyāya saṅgaṇhāmi
an8.24:1.13: ayaṃ samānattatāya saṅgahetabboti taṃ samānattatāya saṅgaṇhāmi
an8.24:1.14: saṃvijjante kho pana me bhante kule bhogā
an8.24:1.15: daḷiddassa kho no tathā sotabbaṃ maññantīti.
an8.24:1.17: yoni kho tyāyaṃ hatthaka mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahetuṃ
an8.24:1.18: yepi hi keci hatthaka atītamaddhānaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahesuṃ sabbe te imeheva catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgahesuṃ
an8.24:1.19: yepi hi keci hatthaka anāgatamaddhānaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇ hissanti sabbe te imeheva catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhissanti
an8.24:1.20: yepi hi keci hatthaka etarahi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhanti sabbe te imeheva catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantīti.
an8.24:2.1: athakho hatthako āḷavako bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.24:2.2: athakho bhagavā acirapakkante hatthake āḷavake bhikkhū āmantesi
an8.24:2.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha
an8.24:2.13: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutadhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhārethāti. 25
